name: Capability using FHRR bind
description: Substrate-product capability of binding role-filler pairs via FHRR circular convolution. Used universally by PP rows requiring relational encoding: role-filler memory, fact storage (PP-225 kb100K), schema slots (PP-369), language-math unified codebook (PP-367). Anchors substrate's algebraic relational primitive.

name: Capability using FHRR unbind
description: Substrate-product capability of unbinding role-filler pairs via FHRR involution. Inverse of fhrr_bind; recovers filler given role + bound representation. Underlies cleanup-based retrieval (PP-225 kb100K), fact recall, slot-extraction (PP-369), and discriminative classification feature retrieval.

name: Capability using superposition
description: Substrate-product capability of superposing multiple atoms in single hyperdimensional vector. Underlies bundle representations, schema slots holding multiple values, weak-label aggregation, and discriminative feature accumulation. Core to substrate-classical NL stack (PP-364/369/370) + math (PP-375/376/378).

name: Capability using bundling
description: Substrate-product capability of bundling normalized superposition to form set/conjunction representations. Distinct from raw superposition: bundling preserves cleanup-decodability via normalization. Tier-2 schema bundles ubiquitous across NL/math/code PP rows (PP-364/369/375/376/378).

name: Capability using circular convolution
description: Substrate-product capability of binding via circular convolution (HRR mode) or complex-elementwise multiplication (FHRR mode). Algebraic foundation underlying fhrr_bind. Substrate-distinguishing primitive: O(N log N) bound representations dimensionally invariant to set size.

name: Capability using cleanup retrieval
description: Substrate-product capability of nearest-prototype cleanup retrieval. Maps noisy/composite vector to nearest stored atom by cosine similarity. Backbone of substrate fact recall (PP-225), discriminative classification (PP-376/378), and prototype-bundle reasoning routing (PP-371).

name: Capability using Viterbi decoding
description: Substrate-product capability of dynamic-programming sequence decoding via Viterbi algorithm. Used in HMM POS tagging (PP-364), slot-filling (PP-369), NER structured perceptron, chunking. Core sequence-decoder primitive enabling substrate-classical NL stack.

name: Capability using forward algorithm
description: Substrate-product capability of computing forward probabilities over hidden-state sequences. Companion to Viterbi (max-product) using sum-product. Used for marginal posteriors + EM training (PP-375 weak-label E-step). Bridges generative HMM to discriminative variants.

name: Capability using backward algorithm
description: Substrate-product capability of computing backward probabilities over hidden-state sequences. Pair-rule with forward_algorithm for full posteriors + EM training. Used in HMM smoothing + sequence-labeling posterior estimates.

name: Capability using EM algorithm
description: Substrate-product capability of expectation-maximization for latent-variable inference + weak-label training. Underlies answer-consistency weak labels (PP-375/376) + bootstrap-NB training (PP-370) + HMM parameter estimation. Substrate-distinguishing low-supervision lever.

name: Capability using Bayesian inference
description: Substrate-product capability of posterior estimation via Bayes rule. Underlies count-NB (PP-370 intent), HMM emissions (PP-364), reasoning composition routing (PP-371 Bayesian reasoning category), and uncertainty quantification (conformal+isotonic).

name: Capability using Hungarian assignment
description: Substrate-product capability of bipartite matching with cost matrix via Hungarian algorithm. Drives discriminative-weighted role-assigner (substrate_discriminative_beats_generative_asymmetric_NL memory). Polynomial-time optimal matching for spec extraction + entity-role binding.

name: Capability using Chu-Liu-Edmonds
description: Substrate-product capability of maximum-spanning-arborescence for dependency-parse tree decoding via Chu-Liu-Edmonds. Pairs with Eisner (projective) + Viterbi (chain) as substrate-CRF universal Tier-3 decoder primitives per substrate-CRF universal library design.

name: Capability using dynamic programming
description: Substrate-product capability of memoized recursive decomposition. Generic algorithmic frame underlying Viterbi + forward + backward + Eisner + Chu-Liu-Edmonds. Layer 3 archaeology proposed prob-DP + graph_traversal unification (cycle #2).

name: Capability using discriminative perceptron
description: Substrate-product capability of online perceptron training for asymmetric structured tasks. Lifts substrate from count-NB symmetric baseline. Universal lever validated across 11+ Tier-A tasks: POS/NER/parse/math/code/text-class/sentiment per discriminative_weighting_universal memory.

name: Capability using Shannon entropy
description: Substrate-product capability of measuring distribution uncertainty via Shannon entropy. Used in feature selection + uncertainty quantification (conformal+isotonic ECE 0.044) + reasoning routing posterior diagnostics + drift detection (Layer 8 substrate-self-evaluation).

name: Capability using KL divergence
description: Substrate-product capability of measuring distribution divergence. Used in BOCPD bounded changepoint detection (full-research-ledger drill) + drift detection (Layer 8) + distributional shift diagnostics + EM convergence monitoring.

name: Capability using probability distribution
description: Substrate-product capability of representing + reasoning over probability distributions. Foundation for count-NB (PP-370), Bayesian inference, HMM emissions, uncertainty quantification, and EM weak-label training. Tier-1 underlies most substrate-classical NL + math.
